description: Starts a short reading placement test (about 15 multiple choice questions, levels A1 to C1) from SpeakBase's CEFR item bank. The test is for ENGLISH. For any other language it returns a link to SpeakBase's free spoken level test for that language instead. Returns a test_id and 5 short texts with their questions and lettered options; answer keys stay on the server. The answers are scored by score_placement_test.

language.description: The language being learned, two-letter code.

native_language.description: The learner's own language as a two-letter code (for example he, es, ar). Used for explanations and for the language of the SpeakBase page the links open in.

name: start_placement_test
title: Start a CEFR placement test
